root_cause.text: The rxrpc DATA and RESPONSE decryption paths only checked skb_cloned() before doing in-place decryption, so skbs with non-cloned but externally shared paged fragments or frag lists were modified through skb_to_sgvec() without first being unshared.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states packets were copied “only when skb_cloned() is true,” while “not cloned but still carries externally-owned paged fragments … falls through to the in-place decryption path,” and the patch fixes this by extending the condition in rxrpc_input_call_event() and rxrpc_verify_response() to also check skb_has_frag_list(skb) and skb_has_shared_frag(skb).

intent_record.intent_summary: Unshare encrypted RXRPC DATA skbs when they are cloned or contain shared fragments so in-place decryption only modifies writable packet buffers.
intent_record.what: The condition guarding packet unsharing was expanded from checking only `skb_cloned(skb)` to checking `skb_cloned(skb) || skb_has_frag_list(skb) || skb_has_shared_frag(skb)` for DATA packets with a nonzero security index.
intent_record.how: At runtime, encrypted DATA packets are now unshared not only when the skb is cloned, but also when it contains a frag list or shared fragments, ensuring the buffer is safely writable before in-place decryption and preventing modification of shared packet data.

intent_record.intent_summary: Copy received packets before in-place decryption when they are cloned, have frag lists, or contain shared fragments to avoid unsafe buffer modification.
intent_record.what: The condition guarding packet copying in rxrpc_verify_response() was expanded from checking only skb_cloned(skb) to also checking skb_has_frag_list(skb) and skb_has_shared_frag(skb), with the if statement split across two lines.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function will now copy not only cloned sk_buffs but also packets that contain a frag list or shared fragments before performing in-place decryption, preventing modification of shared or non-linear packet data that is not safe to decrypt in place.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition is the gate for copying/unsharing an skb before in-place decryption in the RESPONSE path. Because it only checks skb_cloned(skb), it fails to protect skbs that are not cloned but still have externally shared paged fragments or frag lists, leading to unsafe modification of shared packet data during decryption.

The check is incomplete because it only tests skb_cloned(skb), missing non-cloned skbs with shared fragments or frag lists, which can then be modified unsafely through the decryption scatterlist path.

The vulnerable root cause is that DATA/RESPONSE decryption only checked `skb_cloned()` before allowing in-place modification, but did not account for other forms of sharing such as externally shared paged fragments or frag lists. That matches the stated root cause exactly. Therefore the vulnerable construct is present (`has_bug=true`).
